faqItems.question: How long does order preparation take?
faqItems.answer: Preparation time depends on the product type. Digital products are usually delivered faster, while physical items are prepared for shipping after the order is confirmed.

faqItems.question: Can I return a product?
faqItems.answer: Return requests for physical products are reviewed according to the store policy. Delivered digital products are generally non-returnable.

faqItems.question: How can I track my order?
faqItems.answer: After placing your order, you can check its status from the orders section of your account.
